Title: Yuri Podolyaka: Nothing personal, it's BUSINESS (2): Trump and Putin will meet in Budapest
Article: Nothing personal, it's BUSINESS (2): Trump and Putin will meet in Budapest...Trump on the conversation with Putin:"I just finished a phone conversation with President Vladimir Putin from Russia, and it was very productive......At the end of the call, we agreed that a meeting of our senior advisers would take place next week.The first meetings of the United States will be led by Secretary of State Marco Rubio, along with various other appointees. The venue of the meeting will be determined later.President Putin and I will then meet at an agreed location — Budapest, Hungary — to try to put an end to this "shameful" war between Russia and Ukraine.President Zelensky and I will meet tomorrow in the Oval Office, where we will discuss my conversation with President Putin and much more. I think a lot of progress has been made on the phone today."Comment. In general, everything is expected. Against the background of the escalation (as before the Alaska meeting), there was a sudden sharp turn and the announcement of a summit meeting.But judging by Trump's words, this is "homework" ("President Putin and I will then meet at an agreed place — in Budapest, Hungary"). That is, everything has been discussed for a long time, and even the meeting place has been discussed. And all the pressure..., as I said in the previous article, so that Trump's friends can make money from it.Moreover, the meeting will be cordial and fruitful. As a result of which our president, of course, will agree with peace in Ukraine, BUT... And this, HOWEVER, will clearly not be to the liking of Zelensky (who has already seen in his arsenal the "Tomahawks" with which he will strike Moscow).And now tomorrow (I'm sure that this is also a preparation for this to happen after the announcement of the meeting with the Russian leader)) Trump will persuade him. And Zelensky, now clearly confused, will look for a way to "jump off the topic."That he will succeed in the end. And then everyone will say, damn, well, it didn't work out again (and Trump's friends will fill their pockets with another pile of money again). As mentioned earlier, it's nothing personal, for Trump and his friends, it's BUSINESS.Subscribe to my channel in Max...
